rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered a broken wrist on the policyholder's premises due to an icy condition, triggering bodily injury liability coverage.
claim_summary: Third-party bodily injury claim: neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on an icy walkway in front of the policyholder's house during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bill recovery. High severity due to pediatric injury.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
case_facts.claim_trigger: Medical bills from injury on policyholder's premises
